evidence.reason: The fixture initializes a temporary repository and commits with a local fixture identity, but it never overrides an inherited `commit.gpgSign=true`. In that environment Git attempts to sign with the fixture committer identity; if no matching signing key exists, the baseline commit at line 94 fails and all `DeployTests` error in `setUp`. Setting repository-local `commit.gpgSign=false` before the first commit is a routine test isolation fix and also covers the later fixture commit.
